$comment: Gzip byte budgets per asset group in apps/web/dist/assets, matched by filename regex and extension-agnostic. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `npm run build`. A file in dist/assets that matches no exclude rule and no group fails the build, so a new kind of asset has to be budgeted on purpose. Raise a budget only with a reason in the commit message; it exists so a regression fails CI instead of being noticed on a phone.

exclude.name: sourcemaps
exclude.reason: vite.config.ts emits build.sourcemap: "hidden" for local debugging only; apps/web/Dockerfile deletes every *.map before the image ships, so these bytes never reach a phone and budgeting them would budget nothing real.
